description: Next version from commits — Computes the next semantic version and a release changelog from Conventional Commits messages (semantic-release / release-please logic, offline). commits= one subject per line (newline-separated, or set sep=|); lines starting 'BREAKING CHANGE:' attach to the previous commit. current= the last released version (default 0.0.0). Rules: BREAKING CHANGE or type! = major, feat = minor, fix/perf/revert = patch, docs/chore/style/refactor/test/build/ci = no release. 0.x versions bump minor for breaking changes (zero_major=major to override). pre=rc|beta|alpha makes prereleases (2.0.0-rc.1 -> rc.2). all=1 adds non-release sections. Flags non-conventional messages with a suggested rewrite. Returns next, tag, bump, reasons, counts, breaking list and a Markdown changelog. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
